evidence_limits: New C++ interfaces and actual borrowed storage/token cells, not original binary ABI or production publication.
Current CRT memmove_s, invalid-parameter callback, allocation and C++ exceptions are library boundaries, not native exception/handler ownership emulation.
Original oracle exercises normal list paths only; native classifier/FH3, private spills, corrupt ranges, hardware faults and gameplay untested.
Fixture parser and alternate type predicates are explicit boundary probes. Actual manager/parser/loader composition and queue shutdown remain open.
